spec.title: Ravena — Jogador
spec.description: Ficha de um jogador da economia: saldo, extrato diário e comandos. Mesma fonte do painel da economia (analytics.db). Mostra nome e telefone (decisão de produto: moeda de jogo; Grafana só por túnel ou com senha). O analytics.db guarda epoch em ms; o frser-sqlite-datasource lê colunas de tempo em segundos, por isso o / 1000 nos SELECT.

spec.queryText: SELECT ts / 1000 AS time, CASE currency WHEN 'zinthos' THEN 'Zinthos' WHEN 'petalitas' THEN 'Petalitas' WHEN 'runas' THEN 'Runas' ELSE 'Todas' END || ': ' || label AS text, COALESCE(currency, 'todas') AS tags FROM annotations WHERE COALESCE(origin, 'manual') NOT IN ('possivel', 'descartada') AND ts >= $__from - 12 * 604800000 AND ts < $__to
spec.rawQueryText: SELECT ts / 1000 AS time, CASE currency WHEN 'zinthos' THEN 'Zinthos' WHEN 'petalitas' THEN 'Petalitas' WHEN 'runas' THEN 'Runas' ELSE 'Todas' END || ': ' || label AS text, COALESCE(currency, 'todas') AS tags FROM annotations WHERE COALESCE(origin, 'manual') NOT IN ('possivel', 'descartada') AND ts >= $__from - 12 * 604800000 AND ts < $__to

spec.title: Encontrar jogador (busca por nome, telefone ou ID)
spec.description: Digite parte do nome, do telefone ou do ID no campo 'Buscar' no topo e clique no nome para abrir a ficha.

spec.queryText:
WITH pp AS (
  SELECT i.person, MAX(i.phone) AS phone, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.id_kind) AS tipos, MAX(i.name) AS nome
  FROM identities i GROUP BY i.person
),
bal AS (
  SELECT i.person,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.currency = 'zinthos' THEN p.balance END) AS z, SUM(CASE WHEN p.currency = 'runas' THEN p.balance END) AS r,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.currency = 'petalitas' THEN p.balance END) AS pt
  FROM players p JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY i.person
),
cmds AS (
  SELECT i.person, SUM(a.uses) AS u FROM player_activity_daily a JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = a.player_id
  WHERE a.day >= $__to - 604800000 AND a.day < $__to GROUP BY i.person
)
SELECT pp.person AS "Pessoa", COALESCE(pp.nome, '—') AS "Nome", CASE WHEN pp.phone IS NOT NULL THEN '+' || pp.phone WHEN pp.person LIKE 'tg:%' THEN 'Telegram ' || substr(pp.person, 4) WHEN pp.person LIKE 'lid:%' THEN 'LID ' || substr(pp.person, 5) ELSE pp.person END AS "Telefone / ID", pp.tipos AS "Tipo de ID",
  bal.z AS "Zinthos", bal.r AS "Runas", bal.pt AS "Petalitas", cmds.u AS "Comandos (7 dias)"
FROM pp LEFT JOIN bal ON bal.person = pp.person LEFT JOIN cmds ON cmds.person = pp.person
WHERE ${busca:sqlstring} = '' OR pp.nome LIKE '%' || ${busca:sqlstring} || '%' OR pp.person LIKE '%' || ${busca:sqlstring} || '%'
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identities j WHERE j.person = pp.person AND j.player_id LIKE '%' || ${busca:sqlstring} || '%')
ORDER BY COALESCE(bal.z, 0) + COALESCE(bal.r, 0) DESC LIMIT 50

options.content: **Nenhum jogador escolhido.** Clique num nome na tabela acima (ou nas tabelas da aba Jogadores do painel da economia), ou digite a pessoa no campo Jogador: telefone com 13 dígitos, `tg:<id>` ou `lid:<id>`.

spec.title: Ficha do jogador
spec.description: Escolha o jogador clicando num nome (aqui ou nas tabelas da aba Jogadores) ou digitando a pessoa no campo 'Jogador': telefone com 13 dígitos, tg:<id> ou lid:<id>. Período = seletor de tempo.

spec.queryText:
WITH pp AS (
  SELECT i.person, MAX(i.phone) AS phone, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.id_kind) AS tipos, MAX(i.name) AS nome
  FROM identities i GROUP BY i.person
), cur(currency, nome, ordem) AS (VALUES ('zinthos', 'Zinthos', 1), ('petalitas', 'Petalitas', 2), ('runas', 'Runas', 3))
SELECT cur.nome AS "Moeda",
  (SELECT SUM(p.balance) FROM players p JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = p.player_id WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND p.currency = cur.currency) AS "Saldo atual",
  (SELECT SUM(d.amount_in - d.amount_out) FROM player_daily d JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = d.player_id
     WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND d.currency = cur.currency AND d.kind = 'creation' AND d.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND d.day < $__to) AS "Criado no período",
  (SELECT SUM(d.amount_out - d.amount_in) FROM player_daily d JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = d.player_id
     WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND d.currency = cur.currency AND d.kind = 'destruction' AND d.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND d.day < $__to) AS "Destruído no período",
  (SELECT SUM(d.amount_in - d.amount_out) FROM player_daily d JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = d.player_id
     WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND d.currency = cur.currency AND d.kind IN ('exchange_in', 'exchange_out') AND d.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND d.day < $__to) AS "Câmbio (líquido)",
  (SELECT SUM(d.amount_in - d.amount_out) FROM player_daily d JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = d.player_id
     WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND d.currency = cur.currency AND d.kind = 'transfer' AND d.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND d.day < $__to) AS "Transf. (líquido)",
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(i.player_id || ' (' || i.id_kind || ')', ', ') FROM identities i
     WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND i.player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM players p WHERE p.currency = cur.currency
                                    UNION SELECT player_id FROM player_daily d WHERE d.currency = cur.currency)) AS "IDs nesta fonte"
FROM cur ORDER BY cur.ordem

spec.title: Saldo por dia — ${moeda} — jogador escolhido
spec.description: Saldo no fim de cada dia econômico (o dia corrente = agora). Petalitas: só desde a primeira carga.

spec.queryText:
SELECT b.day / 1000 AS time, SUM(b.balance) AS "Saldo no fim do dia"
FROM player_balance_daily b JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = b.player_id
WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND b.currency = '${moeda}' AND b.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND b.day < $__to
GROUP BY b.day ORDER BY b.day
spec.rawQueryText:
SELECT b.day / 1000 AS time, SUM(b.balance) AS "Saldo no fim do dia"
FROM player_balance_daily b JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = b.player_id
WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND b.currency = '${moeda}' AND b.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND b.day < $__to
GROUP BY b.day ORDER BY b.day

spec.title: Fluxo por motivo e dia — ${moeda} — jogador escolhido
spec.description: Líquido (entrou − saiu) por motivo e dia econômico.

spec.queryText:
SELECT d.day / 1000 AS time, COALESCE(l.label, d.reason) AS "Motivo", SUM(d.amount_in - d.amount_out) AS "Líquido"
FROM player_daily d JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = d.player_id
LEFT JOIN reason_labels l ON l.currency = d.currency AND l.reason = d.reason
WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND d.currency = '${moeda}' AND d.kind <> 'non_monetary' AND d.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND d.day < $__to
GROUP BY d.day, d.reason ORDER BY d.day
spec.rawQueryText:
SELECT d.day / 1000 AS time, COALESCE(l.label, d.reason) AS "Motivo", SUM(d.amount_in - d.amount_out) AS "Líquido"
FROM player_daily d JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = d.player_id
LEFT JOIN reason_labels l ON l.currency = d.currency AND l.reason = d.reason
WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND d.currency = '${moeda}' AND d.kind <> 'non_monetary' AND d.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND d.day < $__to
GROUP BY d.day, d.reason ORDER BY d.day

spec.queryText:
SELECT d.day / 1000 AS "Dia", COALESCE(l.label, d.reason) AS "Motivo", CASE d.kind WHEN 'creation' THEN 'Criação' WHEN 'destruction' THEN 'Destruição'
    WHEN 'transfer' THEN 'Transferência' WHEN 'exchange_in' THEN 'Câmbio (entrada)'
    WHEN 'exchange_out' THEN 'Câmbio (saída)' WHEN 'non_monetary' THEN 'Fora do dinheiro'
    ELSE 'Sem mapeamento' END AS "Tipo",
  SUM(d.amount_in) AS "Entrou", SUM(d.amount_out) AS "Saiu", SUM(d.tx_count) AS "Transações"
FROM player_daily d JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = d.player_id
LEFT JOIN reason_labels l ON l.currency = d.currency AND l.reason = d.reason
WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND d.currency = '${moeda}' AND d.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND d.day < $__to
GROUP BY d.day, d.reason ORDER BY d.day DESC, SUM(d.amount_in) + SUM(d.amount_out) DESC
spec.rawQueryText:
SELECT d.day / 1000 AS "Dia", COALESCE(l.label, d.reason) AS "Motivo", CASE d.kind WHEN 'creation' THEN 'Criação' WHEN 'destruction' THEN 'Destruição'
    WHEN 'transfer' THEN 'Transferência' WHEN 'exchange_in' THEN 'Câmbio (entrada)'
    WHEN 'exchange_out' THEN 'Câmbio (saída)' WHEN 'non_monetary' THEN 'Fora do dinheiro'
    ELSE 'Sem mapeamento' END AS "Tipo",

GROUP BY d.day, d.reason ORDER BY d.day DESC, SUM(d.amount_in) + SUM(d.amount_out) DESC
